authority_rule.mechanism: Every record at ADOPT or beyond must carry authority_check.changes_authority == false with an explanatory note. A record with changes_authority == true fails closed with AUTHORITY_CLAIM_REJECTED. Authority questions route to the LAW domain, never through the learning pipeline.

contradiction_rule.mechanism: A record contradicted by later evidence takes outcome CONTRADICTED (terminal), must carry a non-empty contradicted_by naming the contradicting record or evidence, and preserved must be true. A CONTRADICTED record with preserved == false or missing contradicted_by fails closed. The contradicting record goes through the pipeline independently — contradiction never edits or deletes history.
contradiction_rule.statement: Contradicted learnings are preserved and marked, never deleted.

fail_closed_law: Any record violating any gate above makes the lifecycle file INVALID. UNKNOWN ≠ PASS: a missing field is a failure, never an assumption. Implemented records ≠ verified records: a full stage_history with empty evidence fails every gate it claims.
not_claimed: No runtime learning engine — this is the record lifecycle contract, not an executor.
No authority over what counts as verified intelligence in any other domain.
No production or behavioral deployment of any learning.
Ratification — status remains PROPOSED_CANONICAL until Human Director ratification.

The 08-SUCCESSION handoff-verification and 09-EVOLUTION self-optimization lifecycles (sibling build-list children; defined in their own 0002 specs, not here)
Constitutional amendment, governance ratification, and any authority creation or change
purpose: Machine-checkable record lifecycle for the 07-LEARNING pipeline OBSERVE → RECONCILE → CANDIDATE → VERIFY → ADOPT → MEASURE → COMPOUND. Defines the canonical record shape, legal stage transitions, per-stage evidence gates, contradiction preservation, and the authority-never-changes rule. A stored note is not learning; a candidate is not verified learning; measured behavioral effect is the only path to COMPOUND.

record_shape.applicability_conditions: list of strings (required at CANDIDATE and beyond)
record_shape.authority_check: object {changes_authority: false, note: string} (required at ADOPT and beyond)
record_shape.behavioral_effect: object {measured: bool, before: string, after: string} (required at MEASURE and beyond; measured must be true)
record_shape.outcome: exactly one of terminal_outcomes (above); default ACTIVE
record_shape.preserved: bool (must be true when outcome == CONTRADICTED)
record_shape.record_id: string, non-empty, unique within the records array
record_shape.verification_evidence: list of strings (required at VERIFY and beyond)

rejection_rule.mechanism: A record that fails the pipeline takes outcome REJECTED (terminal) and must carry a non-empty rejection_reason. The record is retained for the historical record — rejection is a verdict, not an erasure.
rejection_rule.statement: Rejected records are terminal and named.

scope: LEARN record shape and stage-transition law
Per-stage evidence gates (what must be present before a record may sit at a stage)
Contradiction preservation (contradicted records are preserved and marked, never deleted)
Authority rule (learning never changes authority; authority claims are rejected)

ADOPT.rule: adoption_record must be a non-empty string naming where the behavior changed. authority_check must be an object with changes_authority == false. Any record claiming an authority change is REJECTED: learning never changes authority.

CANDIDATE.rule: applicability_conditions must be a non-empty list of non-empty strings. A candidate without explicit applicability conditions is rejected. A candidate is not verified learning.

COMPOUND.rule: compounding_record must be a non-empty string naming where the learning was reused and with what effect. Compounding without measured behavioral effect is rejected — measurement is the only promotion path from MEASURE.

MEASURE.rule: behavioral_effect must be an object with measured == true and non-empty before/after strings. No measurable behavioral effect → record stays UNVERIFIED for compounding; it may not advance to COMPOUND.

OBSERVE.rule: observation_ref must be a non-empty string naming the verified outcome or observation the record starts from. A note without an observation ref is a note, not a learning record — rejected as a record.

RECONCILE.rule: reconciliation_note must be a non-empty string stating how the observation reconciles with existing intelligence: duplicates merged, conflicts named, or 'novel — no existing intelligence covers this'.

VERIFY.rule: verification_evidence must be a non-empty list of non-empty strings naming what was independently checked, including adversarial consideration. Unverified outcomes stay candidates — they do not advance.

title: Learning Record Lifecycle V1

transition_law.note: A record at stage N must carry stage_history == stages[0..N] exactly. CONTRADICTED and REJECTED are terminal: no further stage advance is legal after either.
